_comment: The practice whose name goes on a generated detail sheet. Copy this, fill it in, and
either pass it with --practice, set SPECLINE_PRACTICE to its path, or save it as
specline-practice.json in the directory ABOVE this repository — the same place the
database and the waiting list live, so it survives a deployment and is never web-served.
This exists because a generated document carries the SUBSCRIBING practice's identity and
never the vendor's. With no profile the title block prints [Practice name] for someone to
fill in, which is the safe failure: a blank gets corrected, another firm's name might not.
In the hosted app the same thing comes from the practices row for the signed-in account.
name: Your Practice Ltd
